title: Nano Banana Proで生成した2枚の画像を入力にして、Seedance 2.0でTopview視点の動画化を行う
content:
Nano Banana Proで生成した2枚の画像を入力にして、Seedance 2.0でTopview視点の動画化を行う  
2枚の画像から5つのシーンを組み合わせて、同一キャラクターを観察しているような構成の動画にする

en.content:
Using two images generated with Nano Banana Pro as input, create a top-view perspective video with Seedance 2.0.  
Combine five scenes from the two images to create a video structured as if observing the same character.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Today's pick for #ImaginaryAIFashion ✨

Feel free to use it as is or make adjustments and try it on!  
Past fashions are in the highlights, so be sure to check them out.

【Prompt (Fashion)】  
Black floral-print midi dress with small multicolored bouquet motifs scattered all over, cream-colored lace ruffled bib panel at the chest, high rounded neckline trimmed with delicate beaded edging, puffed elbow-length sleeves with gathered cuffs, fitted bodice flowing into an A-line skirt, two front patch pockets outlined with white pearl beading, decorative pearl bead trim along the pocket edges and skirt seams, large black satin hair bow, heart-shaped silver dangling earrings, sheer black polka-dot tights, black velvet platform Mary Jane shoes with ankle strap and pearl-studded trim, vintage romantic doll-like styling, fitted silhouette emphasizing waist
